## YouTube and Talks

Add your YouTube channel, selected videos, invited talks, conference recordings, podcast appearances, or public explainers here.

### Featured Video

Replace `VIDEO_ID` with the ID from a YouTube URL.

```{=html}
<div class="video-embed">
  <iframe
    src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/VIDEO_ID"
    title="Featured video"
    allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share"
    allowfullscreen>
  </iframe>
</div>
```
